patterns.note: Asymmetrical section layouts with large, bold headings on one side and supporting visuals or interactive elements on the other, creating dynamic visual balance.
Extremely large, bold sans-serif headings are used to introduce major sections, creating strong visual hierarchy and impact, often paired with smaller, uppercase labels.
A high-contrast color scheme of black and white is consistently punctuated by vibrant, saturated accent colors (electric purple and bright green) for key elements like CTAs and decorative shapes.
The main navigation bar shrinks and gains a backdrop as the user scrolls, while a secondary green navigation bar appears below it, offering additional site exploration options.
Elements within the hero section, specifically the product cards, exhibit a subtle 3D rotation and parallax effect as the user scrolls down the page.
Sections frequently alternate between light (white/light gray) and dark (black/dark gray) backgrounds, providing clear visual separation and rhythm throughout the page.

technique_notes: Full-bleed sections are used with generous vertical padding, often featuring a split layout where large typography is balanced by dynamic visual elements like embedded videos or interactive card displays.

A sophisticated scroll-triggered animation system, likely using GSAP and Locomotive Scroll, orchestrates multiple effects: a sticky header that transforms on scroll, a secondary sticky navigation bar that reveals, and a subtle 3D parallax effect on hero elements as the page scrolls.
Interactive elements like buttons and cards use subtle hover effects, such as background color changes or slight lifts, to indicate interactivity and provide feedback.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) create strong visual impact, complemented by legible body text and small, often uppercase, functional labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (2-4px) on buttons and cards, maintaining a clean, modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and generous, particularly in hero and section breaks, creating a sense of spaciousness and allowing elements to breathe. Content grids within sections are balanced.

standout: This site stands out with its dynamic, scroll-driven interactions, particularly the 3D parallax effect on hero elements and the transforming sticky navigation. The bold, oversized typography combined with a high-contrast palette and vibrant accent colors creates a distinctive, modern, and highly engaging experience that feels premium and developer-focused.
